points.description: States that the slightly different solution (salt concentration) is still within the range of tolerance (acceptable range of salt conditions) in which brine shrimp eggs can hatch. Equivalent wording accepted, e.g. the eggs can hatch in a range of salt concentrations, not only the single best one.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying the new solution falls within the eggs' range of tolerance for hatching (equivalent wording accepted). No marks for answers that don't refer to tolerance range, e.g. just saying "the eggs were strong" or "the spoon was only slightly different" without linking to the range of conditions allowing hatching.
rubric.answer_key: The different salt solution is within the range of tolerance for brine shrimp eggs to hatch.
